paper_title: Revisiting the bound on axion-photon coupling from Globular Clusters
suggested_experiment_name: Globular Clusters R-parameter (HB, Ayala et al.)
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (y-axis plotted as g_agamma x 10^-10 GeV^-1; axis multiplier applied)
notes: Ayala et al. 2014 Globular Cluster R-parameter bound: g_agamma < 0.66e-10 GeV^-1 at 95% CL (benchmark case using He abundance Y=0.254 from low-metallicity H II regions, Aver et al.). Mass-independent (flat) bound valid for axion/ALP masses below a few keV (Primakoff production in HB star cores); encoded as horizontal line from 1e-12 eV to ~10 keV, the validity range implied by the paper ('axion mass lower than about 10 keV'). Alternative bounds under different Y assumptions: 0.50e-10 (SBBN Y) and 0.76e-10 (solar Y) GeV^-1; the headline 0.66e-10 value is used.
